modules.behavior: Signed stateful FIR4 stream: every accepted input sample x[n] produces y[n]=3*x[n]-5*x[n-1]+7*x[n-2]-2*x[n-3]. x is signed8 [-128,127]; output is exact signed13, full range [-2169,2166], no saturation. The previous three ACCEPTED samples are initially/reset zero. Advance history ONLY when in_valid && in_ready before a rising edge; invalid or blocked samples never change it. Three elastic slots/capacity3: r3=!v3||out_ready, r2=!v2||r3, r1=!v1||r2, in_ready=r1, out_valid=v3. On a rising edge each ready stage takes OLD preceding stage valid/data; ready stage1 captures current input-valid and its FIR math on accepted input. No bypass. Capture edge k first becomes stage3-valid after edge k+2 when unobstructed, earliest transfer edge k+3 (minimum accepted-transfer age3). Sustain one accepted input and retired output per edge after filling including full retire/advance/replace. Stalls may delay outputs. Hold out_valid and defined signed result stable while blocked; invalid output payload unspecified. Synchronous active-high rst overrides transfers, clears all history and three valid slots ONLY at rising edges. Ready/valid reflect slot state even before an edge while rst asserted; no combinational reset gating. Entirely off-edge reset pulse has no effect on history or validity. Producer holds x and in_valid while blocked except reset abort. Python accepted-transaction oracle MUST keep three signed prior accepted samples in state, reinterpret masked8 input x>=128 as x-256, compute current FIR and advance history once per non-reset step. Return out_data masked13 (value &8191). Supplied rst clears history and returns0. Do NOT model pipeline/latency/validity/occupancy/backpressure in oracle. Each IOExample starts from zero history and after_cycles repeats the SAME accepted input; examples are first/repeated-constant anchors, not latency or an impulse trace.

When known=false, absence of a top annotation is not a failed or unverifiable criterion. Unannotated numeric latency is UNKNOWN, not zero. Preserve the source's exact observable cycles and registered behavior. Annotation presence or absence alone is not independent proof of behavioral correctness; use the fixed source contract, all defined typed latency/minimum transfer age and deterministic verification, without inventing a numeric requirement.
